title: Canonical Evaporating Cloud with parallel branches and assumptions on every leg

assumptions.statement: Customer commitments depend on predictable system flow
Interrupted flow causes late delivery and lost throughput
Reliable operation requires flow to recover from variability
Operating expense consumes the throughput generated by the system
A system with uncontrolled operating cost cannot sustain profitability
Reliable operation requires resources to remain financially viable
Small batches shorten queues and feedback cycles
Smaller transfer batches expose disruption before it spreads
Current variability makes large batches block flow for too long
Current setup practices make small batches more expensive
Current accounting allocates setup cost across the units in each batch
Current capacity cannot absorb more frequent setups
The constrained resource lacks a rule for choosing batch size dynamically
The system lacks a method to protect flow while controlling setup cost
Production and finance lack a shared measure that reconciles flow and unit cost

targetExpressions.objective: Protect system flow AND Control operating cost

verbalizations.rel-d-b: In order to achieve Protect system flow, we must have Produce small batches.
verbalizations.rel-d-d-prime: Produce large batches conflicts with Produce small batches.
